The difference is about 0.0002° of latitude (roughly 0.014 mi) and 0.00023° of longitude (roughly 0.02 mi), so the truck was well within 25 miles. This check passes.

Capacity: the purchase was 49.1 gallons against a 100-gallon tank. The limit is 110 gallons, so this check passes.

The other hold codes (toll, invoice) do not apply to a fuel-card transaction.

The price works out to about $3.56 per gallon (17480 / 49.1 = 356 cents), which is reasonable, and price is not a policy criterion anyway.
